posts.title: Maybe the real vulnerability was not the prompt injection. It was the agent deciding to run a script it never read.

A finding from 0DIN, Mozilla's GenAI bug-bounty platform, points at a different risk: an agent that reasons correctly and runs untrusted code anyway — because clearing an error is the helpful thing to do. A normal-looking GitHub repo held a setup script that pulled its payload from a DNS record at runtime.
